priorityList: Use Warrior of Elune on cooldown.
Apply and maintain Sunfire, Moonfire, and Stellar Flare (if talented).
Cast Celestial Alignment if you have just cast Fury of Elune (unless saving to line up with Convoke the Spirits).
Cast Convoke the Spirits if Celestial Alignment is active and you have less than 40 Astral Power.
Enter regular Eclipse if not entering cooldowns.
Cast Fury of Elune if not entering Celestial Alignment.
Cast Starfire to generate Astral Power (including inside Celestial Alignment due to the Lunar Calling talent).
Maintain Sunfire and Moonfire at all times.
Cast Fury of Elune on cooldown, ideally when the target will remain stationary.
Cast New Moon, Half Moon, and Full Moon to generate Astral Power and avoid capping charges.
Cast Starsurge to spend Astral Power and prevent overcapping.
Cast Starsurge to maintain the Starlord buff if talented.
Cast Warrior of Elune to generate Astral Power or for movement.
Enter Solar Eclipse by casting Starfire.
